summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of linting failing when a module contains a file of the same name as the directory. It ensures that directories with an `__init__.py` file are correctly identified and processed.

issues.description: The patch introduces a behavioral change that may affect how other modules are processed. Specifically, it changes the condition for identifying directories with an `__init__.py` file, which could potentially lead to unexpected behavior in other parts of the codebase.
The patch introduces a new style of checking for file existence, which slightly deviates from the previous approach. This could be improved for consistency with the rest of the codebase.
